replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation: Both parties: this is a driver-filed dispute over the $6.00 cancellation (no-show) fee for trip TRP-00209, which the platform has already refunded to the rider. The driver asks to have it restored. The evidence does not support that, and because the money has already moved in the rider's favour, the order is NO_ACTION — the present state stands and neither party pays anything further. The fee could only stand if the driver held position inside the 150 m Tampines interchange pickup geofence for a continuous 300 seconds (the TRANSPORT_HUB minimum), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap (POL-NS-01(c)). I accept the driver did arrive: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the arrival radius, closing to about 30 m of the pin, which satisfies the POL-NS-02 proximity test. But on the corrected clock the single continuous in-geofence run lasted 236 seconds — 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation — 64 seconds short of 300. The trip record's 10.1-minute wait_time_min runs from the 'arrived' marker, which POL-NS-01(c) expressly does not accept, and cannot carry the fee. Limb (c) therefore fails, so under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, and no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall; POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not. The $6.00 figure is correct in itself — the greater of the $6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee and the $4.00 RYDE_X tier fee — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect; the problem is the dwell, not the sum. On disposition, because the driver is the filing party and the fee has already been reversed (EV-FARE-00209: payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00), the rider's correct position is the one she is already in: the fee stays refunded to the rider, nothing is restored to the driver, and no further sum is owed to the filing party. No escalation is warranted — confidence is above the 0.70 floor; POL-NS-01(c) resolves the difference between the trip record's marker-based figure and the trace; there is no repeat-dispute pattern (disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides, no_show_disputes_30d is 0); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (3 terminations in 88 completed trips, 3.4%); and the deciding fact rests on an unimpaired artifact (EV-GPS-00209, weight 1.0). POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, so no false-arrival referral is made, and no clause produces any other referral on these facts. On the impaired records: EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired (weight 0.85, issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the driver's two messages and the system arrival notice were never read). It does not carry the deciding fact and changes nothing; since the rider sent no message, POL-NS-04 does not apply to her, and the driver's delivered messages and timestamps stand. EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable, and in any event there is only one in-geofence interval to sum. The rider's account and her track (88 stationary fixes within 50–92 m of the pin from 07:43) are consistent with each other, but POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of her presence either way.
